- AE: Ava Moreno; SE: Marcus Liu; CSM: Nina Patel.
POC / demo history:
- 2025-11-15: Intro call (ff_2026-02-14 ref) — described EU-first mandate, GDPR residency requirement. Asked about quick demo of Redwood streaming chat + embeddings in eu-west region.
- 2025-12-02: Hosted API demo (regional endpoints) — showed EU endpoint, latency demo from Amsterdam office. Notes: "demo looked good but want p95 numbers under load".

Requirements / constraints (customer stated):
- Data residency: all user data and extracted embeddings must remain in EU. No cross-border storage for production.
- Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM, SOC2 evidence, audit logs retention 1y, bring-your-own-KMS preferred for keys.
- Latency SLO: chat p95 <100ms EU region; search latency <200ms p95; throughput target ~40 qps for embeddings indexing window.
- Model choices: prefer open/open-weights-first, but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified models if cost/quality better. Need routing policy: EU primary, fallback to EU-compatible quantized model within region; avoid US fallback in production.
Key asks from product/infra teams:
- Architecture diagram showing how Hosted API keeps data in-region and how Dedicated changes that flow.
- Multi-region routing options: prefer active-active EU+NA for DR but need clear guarantees about data residency and which region handles inference.
- Concrete latency numbers for EU Dedicated instance sizes + recommended autoscale settings to meet p95 <100ms at 40 qps.

- Procurement timeline: Legal & Security sign-off expected by 2026-06; procurement start 2026-05 if POC successful.
